name: Oblong Wool Carder Bee
desc: Oblong Wool Carder Bee (Anthidium oblongatum): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 6 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Anthidium oblongatum, the oblong woolcarder bee, is a species of bee in the family Megachilidae, the leaf-cutter, carder, or mason bees.
